messages:
maria: Heads-up — after last night's RBAC matrix refactor I can reproduce a case where org-viewer users can still edit project billing settings. Found via customer report. Repro steps below.

maria: Repro steps: 1) user SSO -> provisioned as viewer at org scope 2) open /orgs/acme/projects/42/billing 3) the edit button is enabled and saves successfully.

alex: ugh. any console logs or audit events? this sounds like scope mismatch between role mapping and the UI gating.

sam: I can repro locally on qa with the migrated role-mapper. Putting a short screen share in #help in 5.

sec-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-20T02:14:08Z detected: unusual role assignment path via scim-sync for tenant acme-corp (rule: role_scope_change).

jordan: checked KMS rotation job logs — rotation job succeeded at 01:52 UTC, no errors. BUT the audit-index pipeline shows no event for role_assignment for the scim-sync batch at 01:55.

lee: quick api dump shows the SCIM payload includes: 
```json
{"userName":"alice@acme.com","roles":[{"name":"viewer","scope":"org"}],"meta":{"source":"okta-scim"}}
```
but our internal role-mapper DB row after processing: `role=viewer, effective_scope=project`

maria: so mapping layer is flipping scope during provision. could be the new role precedence rules we merged. anyone see related changes in the PR?

alex: PR #4127 changed precedence to prefer project-level overrides when both org and project entries exist. Looks like it defaults incorrectly when only org present. I think a bug in fallback logic.

sam: repro indicates UI gating checks the effective_scope field returned by backend; so if mapper returns project, UI enables edit controls.

lee: also noticed audit events for role changes created by admin-UI show up fine; only SCIM-provisioned changes are missing from the audit index. suspect the scim handler doesn't call the audit write path after refactor.

ops-oncall: we should treat this as P1 for customers with SSO provisioning. Recommend temporary mitigations: 1) disable SCIM auto-provisioning for affected tenancies (feature flag) 2) disable billing edit affordance in console for viewers until fix deployed.

sara: agree. I'll open a feature-flag rollout to disable scim-sync for orgs with >0 projects and add a quick console gate. Can do patch now.

alex: proposed immediate fix: revert the precedence change in role-mapper or patch fallback to keep org scope when only org role is present. Revert is fastest.

jordan: hotfix plan: 1) feature-flag scim-sync off (ops) 2) rollback role-mapper PR #4127 in canary (eng-runtime) 3) redeploy audit writer for scim handler (eng-security) 4) run a targeted backfill to emit missing audit events for the last 3 hours.

maria: action items: @sara flip scim feature flag and gate the UI (ETA 20m). @alex coordinate rollback PR (ETA 30m). @jordan prep audit backfill recipe and confirm KMS decryption keys available for backfill. @ops-oncall stand by for tenant toggle.

sam: I've captured the screen and attachments in the help thread. Putting minimal repro script here: 
```
# repro
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" -d '{"role":"viewer","scope":"org"}' https://console.internal/api/v1/scim/users/..
# observe UI edit button enabled
```

lee: note — KMS is unrelated to scope flip, but will be needed for backfill when we sign audit events. confirm KMS key id: projects/redwood/keys/audit-backfill-key.

maria: thanks team. we'll treat this as high-severity. keep updates here. I'll draft a short incident note for legal/compliance since audit events are missing for SCIM changes.

sec-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1109 (severity: high) assigned to eng-security.

ops-oncall: standing by for toggles.

alex: I'll open the revert PR now and ping when CI green.

maria: update: feature flag flipped for acme-corp, they lost auto-provisioning but permissions are safe. continuing rollback + backfill work.

maria: final decision for now: rollback precedence change, patch scim handler to emit audit events, backfill missing events within 6 hours, and add an automated test to fail CI if scim path changes effective_scope.
